latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "china-plate" skill for parsing and validating Chinese vehicle license plates.
- Supports identification of province, city, plate type (regular, new energy, military, police, learner), and format validation.
- Covers all 31 provinces and includes special plate types.
- Fully offline operation, zero network/API requirement.
- Includes full documentation of plate rules and format standards based on GA36-2018.
